mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OSV_VULNERABILITIES (OSV_ID, SCHEMA_VERSION, SUMMARY, DETAILS, PUBL_DATE, MODI_DATE, WITHDRAWN, RAW_JSON) VALUES (#{osvId}, #{schemaVersion}, #{summary}, #{details}, #{publDate}, #{modiDate}, #{withdrawn}, #{rawJson})
INSERT INTO OSV_SEVERITIES (ID, PACKAGE_NAME, ECOSYSTEM, SOURCE, TYPE, SCORE) VALUES (#{id}, #{packageName}, #{ecosystem}, #{source}, #{type}, #{score})
INSERT INTO OSV_AFFECTED_PACKAGES (ID, PACKAGE_IDX, ECOSYSTEM, PACKAGE_NAME, PURL) VALUES (#{id}, #{packageIdx}, #{ecosystem}, #{packageName}, #{purl})
INSERT IGNORE INTO OSV_AFFECTED_PACKAGES_VERSIONS (ID, PACKAGE_IDX, VERSION_IDX, VERSION) VALUES (#{id}, #{packageIdx}, #{versionIdx}, #{version})

INSERT INTO OSV_AFFECTED_PACKAGE_RANGES (ID, PACKAGE_IDX, RANGE_IDX, RANGE_TYPE, REPO, INTRODUCED, FIXED, LAST_AFFECTED, LIMIT_VERSION) VALUES (#{id}, #{packageIdx}, #{rangeIdx}, #{rangeType}, #{repo}, #{introduced}, #{fixed}, #{lastAffected}, #{limitVersion})
INSERT INTO OSV_REFERENCES (OSV_ID, REF_IDX, TYPE, PATCH_LINK) VALUES (#{osvId}, #{refIdx}, #{type}, #{patchLink})
mapper.select: SELECT ID, OSV_ID, MODI_DATE FROM OSV_VULNERABILITIES WHERE OSV_ID = #{osvId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(AFFECTED_PKG_ID), 0) FROM OSV_AFFECTED_PACKAGES WHERE OSV_ID = #{osvId} AND ECOSYSTEM = #{ecosystem} AND PACKAGE_NAME = #{packageName}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(RANGE_INDEX) + 1, 0) AS RANGE_INDEX FROM OSV_AFFECTED_PACKAGE_RANGES WHERE AFFECTED_PKG_ID = #{affectedPkgId}

SELECT TBL.*
, IFNULL(SEC.VULNERABILITY_RESOLUTION, 'Unresolved') AS VULNERABILITY_RESOLUTION
FROM ( SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID AS CVE_ID, M.SEVERITY AS CVSS_SCORE, DATE_FORMAT(M.PUBL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PUBL_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(M.MODI_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS MODI_DATE, M.AFFECTED_VERSION, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P1, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P2, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN, M.SUMMARY AS VULN_SUMMARY, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(PATCH_LINK) FROM OSV_REFERENCES WHERE OSV_ID = M.ID) AS PATCH_LINK, M.ID AS GROUP_KEY_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(A.ALIAS_ID) AS ALIAS_ID, 1 AS PRIORITY FROM OSS_COMPONENTS OC INNER JOIN OSV_SEARCH_MASTER M ON M.SEARCH_NAME_P1 = OC.OSS_NAME AND M.WITHDRAWN_YN = 'N' AND ( (M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 IS NOT NULL AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 <> '' AND FIND_IN_SET(OC.OSS_VERSION, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1) > 0) OR (M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 IS NOT NULL AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 <> '' AND CHECK_VERSION_RANGE(OC.OSS_VERSION, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2) > 0) ) LEFT JOIN OSV_VULNERABILITIES V ON V.OSV_ID = M.ID LEFT JOIN OSV_ALIASES A ON A.ID = V.ID WHERE OC.REFERENCE_ID = #{referenceId} AND OC.REFERENCE_DIV = #{referenceDiv} AND OC.OSS_NAME IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '' AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '-' AND OC.OSS_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_VERSION <> '' AND OC.EXCLUDE_YN <> 'Y' GROUP BY OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID, M.SEVERITY
UNION ALL
SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M_ALIAS.ID AS CVE_ID, M_ALIAS.SEVERITY AS CVSS_SCORE, DATE_FORMAT(M_ALIAS.PUBL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PUBL_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(M_ALIAS.MODI_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS MODI_DATE, M_ALIAS.AFFECTED_VERSION, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P1, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P1, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P2, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P2, M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN, M_ALIAS.SUMMARY AS VULN_SUMMARY, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(PATCH_LINK) FROM OSV_REFERENCES WHERE OSV_ID = M_ALIAS.ID) AS PATCH_LINK, M.ID AS GROUP_KEY_ID, '' AS ALIAS_ID, 1 AS PRIORITY FROM OSS_COMPONENTS OC INNER JOIN OSV_SEARCH_MASTER M ON M.SEARCH_NAME_P1 = OC.OSS_NAME AND M.WITHDRAWN_YN = 'N' INNER JOIN OSV_VULNERABILITIES V ON V.OSV_ID = M.ID INNER JOIN OSV_ALIASES A ON A.ID = V.ID INNER JOIN OSV_SEARCH_MASTER M_ALIAS ON M_ALIAS.ID = A.ALIAS_ID AND ( (M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 IS NOT NULL AND M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 <> '' AND FIND_IN_SET(OC.OSS_VERSION, M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P1) > 0) OR (M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 IS NOT NULL AND M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 <> '' AND CHECK_VERSION_RANGE(OC.OSS_VERSION, M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P2) > 0) ) WHERE OC.REFERENCE_ID = #{referenceId} AND OC.REFERENCE_DIV = #{referenceDiv} AND OC.OSS_NAME IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '' AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '-' AND OC.OSS_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_VERSION <> '' AND OC.EXCLUDE_YN <> 'Y' AND M.ID <> M_ALIAS.ID GROUP BY OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M_ALIAS.ID, M_ALIAS.SEVERITY
UNION ALL
SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID AS CVE_ID, M.SEVERITY AS CVSS_SCORE, DATE_FORMAT(M.PUBL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PUBL_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(M.MODI_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS MODI_DATE, M.AFFECTED_VERSION, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P1, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P2, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN, M.SUMMARY AS VULN_SUMMARY, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(PATCH_LINK) FROM OSV_REFERENCES WHERE OSV_ID = M.ID) AS PATCH_LINK, M.ID AS GROUP_KEY_ID, '' AS ALIAS_ID, 1 AS PRIORITY FROM OSS_COMPONENTS OC INNER JOIN OSS_COMMON COM ON OC.OSS_NAME = COM.OSS_NAME INNER JOIN OSS_NICKNAME NICK ON COM.OSS_COMMON_ID = NICK.OSS_COMMON_ID INNER JOIN OSV_SEARCH_MASTER M ON M.SEARCH_NAME_P1 = NICK.OSS_NICKNAME AND M.WITHDRAWN_YN = 'N' AND ( (M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 IS NOT NULL AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 <> '' AND FIND_IN_SET(OC.OSS_VERSION, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1) > 0) OR (M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 IS NOT NULL AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 <> '' AND CHECK_VERSION_RANGE(OC.OSS_VERSION, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2) > 0) ) WHERE OC.REFERENCE_ID = #{referenceId} AND OC.REFERENCE_DIV = #{referenceDiv} AND OC.OSS_NAME IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '' AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '-' AND OC.OSS_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_VERSION <> '' AND OC.EXCLUDE_YN <> 'Y' GROUP BY OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID, M.SEVERITY
UNION ALL
SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID AS CVE_ID, M.SEVERITY AS CVSS_SCORE, DATE_FORMAT(M.PUBL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PUBL_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(M.MODI_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS MODI_DATE, M.AFFECTED_VERSION, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P1, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P2, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN, M.SUMMARY AS VULN_SUMMARY, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(PATCH_LINK) FROM OSV_REFERENCES WHERE OSV_ID = M.ID) AS PATCH_LINK, M.ID AS GROUP_KEY_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(A.ALIAS_ID) AS ALIAS_ID, 2 AS PRIORITY FROM OSS_COMPONENTS OC INNER JOIN OSS_COMMON COM ON OC.OSS_NAME = COM.OSS_NAME INNER JOIN OSS_DOWNLOADLOCATION DOWN ON COM.OSS_COMMON_ID = DOWN.OSS_COMMON_ID INNER JOIN OSV_SEARCH_MASTER M ON M.SEARCH_NAME_P2 = DOWN.PURL AND IFNULL(DOWN.PURL, '') <> '' AND M.WITHDRAWN_YN = 'N' AND ( (M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 IS NOT NULL AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 <> '' AND FIND_IN_SET(OC.OSS_VERSION, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1) > 0) OR (M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 IS NOT NULL AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 <> '' AND CHECK_VERSION_RANGE(OC.OSS_VERSION, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2) > 0) ) LEFT JOIN OSV_VULNERABILITIES V ON V.OSV_ID = M.ID LEFT JOIN OSV_ALIASES A ON A.ID = V.ID WHERE OC.REFERENCE_ID = #{referenceId} AND OC.REFERENCE_DIV = #{referenceDiv} AND OC.OSS_NAME IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '' AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '-' AND OC.OSS_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_VERSION <> '' AND OC.EXCLUDE_YN <> 'Y' GROUP BY OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID, M.SEVERITY
UNION ALL
SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M_ALIAS.ID AS CVE_ID, M_ALIAS.SEVERITY AS CVSS_SCORE, DATE_FORMAT(M_ALIAS.PUBL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PUBL_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(M_ALIAS.MODI_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS MODI_DATE, M_ALIAS.AFFECTED_VERSION, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P1, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P1, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P2, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P2, M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN, M_ALIAS.SUMMARY AS VULN_SUMMARY, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(PATCH_LINK) FROM OSV_REFERENCES WHERE OSV_ID = M_ALIAS.ID) AS PATCH_LINK, M.ID AS GROUP_KEY_ID, '' AS ALIAS_ID, 2 AS PRIORITY FROM OSS_COMPONENTS OC INNER JOIN OSS_COMMON COM ON OC.OSS_NAME = COM.OSS_NAME INNER JOIN OSS_DOWNLOADLOCATION DOWN ON COM.OSS_COMMON_ID = DOWN.OSS_COMMON_ID INNER JOIN OSV_SEARCH_MASTER M ON M.SEARCH_NAME_P2 = DOWN.PURL AND IFNULL(DOWN.PURL, '') <> '' AND M.WITHDRAWN_YN = 'N' INNER JOIN OSV_VULNERABILITIES V ON V.OSV_ID = M.ID INNER JOIN OSV_ALIASES A ON A.ID = V.ID INNER JOIN OSV_SEARCH_MASTER M_ALIAS ON M_ALIAS.ID = A.ALIAS_ID AND ( (M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 IS NOT NULL AND M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 <> '' AND FIND_IN_SET(OC.OSS_VERSION, M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P1) > 0) OR (M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 IS NOT NULL AND M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 <> '' AND CHECK_VERSION_RANGE(OC.OSS_VERSION, M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P2) > 0) ) WHERE OC.REFERENCE_ID = #{referenceId} AND OC.REFERENCE_DIV = #{referenceDiv} AND OC.OSS_NAME IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '' AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '-' AND OC.OSS_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_VERSION <> '' AND OC.EXCLUDE_YN <> 'Y' AND M.ID <> M_ALIAS.ID GROUP BY OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M_ALIAS.ID, M_ALIAS.SEVERITY
UNION ALL
SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID AS CVE_ID, M.SEVERITY AS CVSS_SCORE, DATE_FORMAT(M.PUBL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PUBL_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(M.MODI_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS MODI_DATE, M.AFFECTED_VERSION, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P1, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P2, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN, M.SUMMARY AS VULN_SUMMARY, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(PATCH_LINK) FROM OSV_REFERENCES WHERE OSV_ID = M.ID) AS PATCH_LINK, M.ID AS GROUP_KEY_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(A.ALIAS_ID) AS ALIAS_ID, 3 AS PRIORITY FROM OSS_COMPONENTS OC INNER JOIN OSV_SEARCH_MASTER M ON M.SEARCH_NAME_P3 = OC.OSS_NAME AND M.WITHDRAWN_YN = 'N' AND ( (M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 IS NOT NULL AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 <> '' AND FIND_IN_SET(OC.OSS_VERSION, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1) > 0) OR (M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 IS NOT NULL AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 <> '' AND CHECK_VERSION_RANGE(OC.OSS_VERSION, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2) > 0) ) LEFT JOIN OSV_VULNERABILITIES V ON V.OSV_ID = M.ID LEFT JOIN OSV_ALIASES A ON A.ID = V.ID WHERE OC.REFERENCE_ID = #{referenceId} AND OC.REFERENCE_DIV = #{referenceDiv} AND OC.OSS_NAME IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '' AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '-' AND OC.OSS_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_VERSION <> '' AND OC.EXCLUDE_YN <> 'Y' GROUP BY OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID, M.SEVERITY
UNION ALL
SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M_ALIAS.ID AS CVE_ID, M_ALIAS.SEVERITY AS CVSS_SCORE, DATE_FORMAT(M_ALIAS.PUBL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PUBL_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(M_ALIAS.MODI_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS MODI_DATE, M_ALIAS.AFFECTED_VERSION, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P1, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P1, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P2, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P2, M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN, M_ALIAS.SUMMARY AS VULN_SUMMARY, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(PATCH_LINK) FROM OSV_REFERENCES WHERE OSV_ID = M_ALIAS.ID) AS PATCH_LINK, M.ID AS GROUP_KEY_ID, '' AS ALIAS_ID, 3 AS PRIORITY FROM OSS_COMPONENTS OC INNER JOIN OSV_SEARCH_MASTER M ON M.SEARCH_NAME_P3 = OC.OSS_NAME AND M.WITHDRAWN_YN = 'N' INNER JOIN OSV_VULNERABILITIES V ON V.OSV_ID = M.ID INNER JOIN OSV_ALIASES A ON A.ID = V.ID INNER JOIN OSV_SEARCH_MASTER M_ALIAS ON M_ALIAS.ID = A.ALIAS_ID AND ( (M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 IS NOT NULL AND M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 <> '' AND FIND_IN_SET(OC.OSS_VERSION, M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P1) > 0) OR (M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 IS NOT NULL AND M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 <> '' AND CHECK_VERSION_RANGE(OC.OSS_VERSION, M_ALIAS.SEARCH_VERSION_P2) > 0) ) WHERE OC.REFERENCE_ID = #{referenceId} AND OC.REFERENCE_DIV = #{referenceDiv} AND OC.OSS_NAME IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '' AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '-' AND OC.OSS_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_VERSION <> '' AND OC.EXCLUDE_YN <> 'Y' AND M.ID <> M_ALIAS.ID GROUP BY OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M_ALIAS.ID, M_ALIAS.SEVERITY
UNION ALL
SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID AS CVE_ID, M.SEVERITY AS CVSS_SCORE, DATE_FORMAT(M.PUBL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PUBL_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(M.MODI_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS MODI_DATE, M.AFFECTED_VERSION, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P1, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P2, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN, M.SUMMARY AS VULN_SUMMARY, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(PATCH_LINK) FROM OSV_REFERENCES WHERE OSV_ID = M.ID) AS PATCH_LINK, M.ID AS GROUP_KEY_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(A.ALIAS_ID) AS ALIAS_ID, 3 AS PRIORITY FROM OSS_COMPONENTS OC INNER JOIN OSS_COMMON COM ON OC.OSS_NAME = COM.OSS_NAME INNER JOIN OSS_NICKNAME NICK ON COM.OSS_COMMON_ID = NICK.OSS_COMMON_ID INNER JOIN OSV_SEARCH_MASTER M ON M.SEARCH_NAME_P3 = NICK.OSS_NICKNAME AND M.WITHDRAWN_YN = 'N' AND ( (M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 IS NOT NULL AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 <> '' AND FIND_IN_SET(OC.OSS_VERSION, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1) > 0) OR (M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 IS NOT NULL AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 <> '' AND CHECK_VERSION_RANGE(OC.OSS_VERSION, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2) > 0) ) LEFT JOIN OSV_VULNERABILITIES V ON V.OSV_ID = M.ID LEFT JOIN OSV_ALIASES A ON A.ID = V.ID WHERE OC.REFERENCE_ID = #{referenceId} AND OC.REFERENCE_DIV = #{referenceDiv} AND OC.OSS_NAME IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '' AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '-' AND OC.EXCLUDE_YN <> 'Y' GROUP BY OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID, M.SEVERITY
UNION ALL
SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID AS CVE_ID, MAX(M.SEVERITY) AS CVSS_SCORE, DATE_FORMAT(M.PUBL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PUBL_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(M.MODI_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS MODI_DATE, M.AFFECTED_VERSION, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P1, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P2, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN, M.SUMMARY AS VULN_SUMMARY, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(PATCH_LINK) FROM OSV_REFERENCES WHERE OSV_ID = M.ID) AS PATCH_LINK, M.ID AS GROUP_KEY_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(A.ALIAS_ID) AS ALIAS_ID, 1 AS PRIORITY FROM OSS_COMPONENTS OC INNER JOIN OSV_SEARCH_MASTER M ON M.SEARCH_NAME_P1 = OC.OSS_NAME AND M.WITHDRAWN_YN = 'N' AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN OSV_VULNERABILITIES V ON V.OSV_ID = M.ID LEFT JOIN OSV_ALIASES A ON A.ID = V.ID WHERE OC.REFERENCE_ID = #{referenceId} AND OC.REFERENCE_DIV = #{referenceDiv} AND OC.OSS_NAME IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '' AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '-' AND IFNULL(OC.OSS_VERSION, '') = '' AND OC.EXCLUDE_YN <> 'Y' GROUP BY OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID
UNION ALL
SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID AS CVE_ID, MAX(M.SEVERITY) AS CVSS_SCORE, DATE_FORMAT(M.PUBL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PUBL_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(M.MODI_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS MODI_DATE, M.AFFECTED_VERSION, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P1, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P2, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN, M.SUMMARY AS VULN_SUMMARY, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(PATCH_LINK) FROM OSV_REFERENCES WHERE OSV_ID = M.ID) AS PATCH_LINK, M.ID AS GROUP_KEY_ID, '' AS ALIAS_ID, 1 AS PRIORITY FROM OSS_COMPONENTS OC INNER JOIN OSS_COMMON COM ON OC.OSS_NAME = COM.OSS_NAME INNER JOIN OSS_NICKNAME NICK ON COM.OSS_COMMON_ID = NICK.OSS_COMMON_ID INNER JOIN OSV_SEARCH_MASTER M ON M.SEARCH_NAME_P1 = NICK.OSS_NICKNAME AND M.WITHDRAWN_YN = 'N' AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN = 'Y' WHERE OC.REFERENCE_ID = #{referenceId} AND OC.REFERENCE_DIV = #{referenceDiv} AND OC.OSS_NAME IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '' AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '-' AND IFNULL(OC.OSS_VERSION, '') = '' AND OC.EXCLUDE_YN <> 'Y' GROUP BY OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID
UNION ALL
SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID AS CVE_ID, MAX(M.SEVERITY) AS CVSS_SCORE, DATE_FORMAT(M.PUBL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PUBL_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(M.MODI_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS MODI_DATE, M.AFFECTED_VERSION, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P1, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P2, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN, M.SUMMARY AS VULN_SUMMARY, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(PATCH_LINK) FROM OSV_REFERENCES WHERE OSV_ID = M.ID) AS PATCH_LINK, M.ID AS GROUP_KEY_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(A.ALIAS_ID) AS ALIAS_ID, 2 AS PRIORITY FROM OSS_COMPONENTS OC INNER JOIN OSS_COMMON COM ON OC.OSS_NAME = COM.OSS_NAME INNER JOIN OSS_DOWNLOADLOCATION DOWN ON COM.OSS_COMMON_ID = DOWN.OSS_COMMON_ID INNER JOIN OSV_SEARCH_MASTER M ON M.SEARCH_NAME_P2 = DOWN.PURL AND IFNULL(DOWN.PURL, '') <> '' AND M.WITHDRAWN_YN = 'N' AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN OSV_VULNERABILITIES V ON V.OSV_ID = M.ID LEFT JOIN OSV_ALIASES A ON A.ID = V.ID WHERE OC.REFERENCE_ID = #{referenceId} AND OC.REFERENCE_DIV = #{referenceDiv} AND OC.OSS_NAME IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '' AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '-' AND IFNULL(OC.OSS_VERSION, '') = '' AND OC.EXCLUDE_YN <> 'Y' GROUP BY OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID
UNION ALL
SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID AS CVE_ID, MAX(M.SEVERITY) AS CVSS_SCORE, DATE_FORMAT(M.PUBL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PUBL_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(M.MODI_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS MODI_DATE, M.AFFECTED_VERSION, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P1, GROUP_CONCAT(NULLIF(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2, '') SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P2, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN, M.SUMMARY AS VULN_SUMMARY, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(PATCH_LINK) FROM OSV_REFERENCES WHERE OSV_ID = M.ID) AS PATCH_LINK, M.ID AS GROUP_KEY_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(A.ALIAS_ID) AS ALIAS_ID, 3 AS PRIORITY FROM OSS_COMPONENTS OC INNER JOIN OSV_SEARCH_MASTER M ON M.SEARCH_NAME_P3 = OC.OSS_NAME AND M.WITHDRAWN_YN = 'N' AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN OSV_VULNERABILITIES V ON V.OSV_ID = M.ID LEFT JOIN OSV_ALIASES A ON A.ID = V.ID WHERE OC.REFERENCE_ID = #{referenceId} AND OC.REFERENCE_DIV = #{referenceDiv} AND OC.OSS_NAME IS NOT NULL AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '' AND OC.OSS_NAME <> '-' AND IFNULL(OC.OSS_VERSION, '') = '' AND OC.EXCLUDE_YN <> 'Y' GROUP BY OC.OSS_NAME, OC.OSS_VERSION, M.ID ) TBL
LEFT JOIN NVD_DATA_SECURITY SEC ON SEC.REFERENCE_ID = #{referenceId} AND SEC.OSS_NAME = TBL.OSS_NAME AND SEC.OSS_VERSION = TBL.OSS_VERSION AND SEC.CVE_ID = TBL.CVE_ID
ORDER BY TBL.OSS_NAME ASC, TBL.OSS_VERSION ASC, TBL.GROUP_KEY_ID ASC, CASE WHEN TBL.CVE_ID = TBL.GROUP_KEY_ID THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, TBL.CVE_ID ASC

SELECT M.ID, M.ID AS CVE_ID, GROUP_CONCAT(A.ALIAS_ID) AS ALIAS_ID, M.SOURCE, M.COMPONENT, M.AFFECTED_VERSION, M.SEVERITY, M.SEVERITY_TYPE, M.MODI_DATE, M.PUBL_DATE, M.SUMMARY, M.WITHDRAWN_YN, M.SEARCH_NAME_P1, M.SEARCH_NAME_P2, M.SEARCH_NAME_P3, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1_YN, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2_YN, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN, 2 AS PRIORITY FROM OSV_SEARCH_MASTER M LEFT JOIN OSV_VULNERABILITIES V ON M.ID = V.OSV_ID LEFT JOIN OSV_ALIASES A ON V.ID = A.ID WHERE M.WITHDRAWN_YN = 'N'
AND ( (M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 IS NOT NULL AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 <> '' AND FIND_IN_SET(#{ossVersion}, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1) > 0) OR (M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 IS NOT NULL AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 <> '' AND CHECK_VERSION_RANGE(#{ossVersion}, M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2) > 0) )
AND M.SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN = 'Y'
AND M.SEARCH_NAME_P2 IN
#{purl}
GROUP BY M.ID ORDER BY M.ID ASC, M.MODI_DATE DESC

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE OSV_RANGE_TEMP AS SELECT ID AS INT_ID, PACKAGE_IDX, GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT( CASE WHEN IFNULL(INTRODUCED, '') <> '' THEN CONCAT('[', INTRODUCED) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN IFNULL(INTRODUCED, '') <> '' AND (IFNULL(FIXED, '') <> '' OR IFNULL(LAST_AFFECTED, '') <> '') THEN ', ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN IFNULL(FIXED, '') <> '' THEN CONCAT(FIXED, ')') WHEN IFNULL(LAST_AFFECTED, '') <> '' THEN CONCAT(LAST_AFFECTED, ']') ELSE '' END ) ORDER BY RANGE_IDX ASC SEPARATOR ',' ) AS RANGE_VERSION_TEXT, MAX(CASE WHEN RANGE_TYPE = 'SEMVER' THEN 'Y' END) AS IS_SEMVER_TYPE, GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN RANGE_TYPE = 'SEMVER' THEN CONCAT( IFNULL(INTRODUCED, ''), '~', IFNULL(FIXED, IFNULL(LAST_AFFECTED, '')) ) END ORDER BY RANGE_IDX ASC SEPARATOR '|' ) AS SEMVER_RANGE_RAW, MIN(CASE WHEN INTRODUCED = '0' OR INTRODUCED = '' THEN IFNULL(FIXED, LAST_AFFECTED) ELSE INTRODUCED END) AS SORT_VERSION FROM OSV_AFFECTED_PACKAGE_RANGES GROUP BY ID, PACKAGE_IDX
CREATE INDEX IDX_TMP_RANGE ON OSV_RANGE_TEMP(INT_ID, PACKAGE_IDX)
DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS OSV_VERSION_TEMP

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE OSV_VERSION_TEMP AS SELECT ID AS INT_ID, PACKAGE_IDX, CASE WHEN COUNT(VERSION) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS HAS_VERSIONS_LIST, GROUP_CONCAT(VERSION ORDER BY CASE WHEN VERSION REGEXP '^[0-9]' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, LPAD(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(VERSION, '.', 1), '.', -1), 10, '0') ASC, LPAD(CASE WHEN VERSION LIKE '%.%' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(VERSION, '.', 2), '.', -1) ELSE '0' END, 10, '0') ASC, LPAD(CASE WHEN VERSION LIKE '%.%.%' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(VERSION, '.', 3), '.', -1) ELSE '0' END, 10, '0') ASC, LPAD(CASE WHEN VERSION LIKE '%.%.%.%' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(VERSION, '.', 4), '.', -1) ELSE '0' END, 10, '0') ASC, VERSION ASC SEPARATOR ',' ) AS VERSION_TEXT, MIN(VERSION) AS SORT_VERSION FROM OSV_AFFECTED_PACKAGES_VERSIONS GROUP BY ID, PACKAGE_IDX
CREATE INDEX IDX_TMP_VERSION ON OSV_VERSION_TEMP(INT_ID, PACKAGE_IDX)
DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS OSV_SEVERITY_TEMP

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE OSV_SEVERITY_TEMP AS SELECT INT_ID, TYPE, SCORE FROM ( SELECT ID AS INT_ID, TYPE, SCORE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER( PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN PACKAGE_NAME = '*' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ASC, CASE SOURCE WHEN 'PACKAGE' THEN 1 WHEN 'GLOBAL' THEN 2 WHEN 'PACKAGE_DB' THEN 3 WHEN 'GLOBAL_DB' THEN 4 WHEN 'PACKAGE_ECO' THEN 5 ELSE 99 END, CASE TYPE WHEN 'CVSS_V4' THEN 1 WHEN 'CVSS_V3' THEN 2 WHEN 'CVSS_V2' THEN 3 WHEN 'Ubuntu' THEN 4 WHEN 'N/A' THEN 5 ELSE 99 END ) AS RN FROM OSV_SEVERITIES ) X WHERE RN = 1
DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS OSV_PRE_MERGE_TEMP

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE OSV_PRE_MERGE_TEMP AS SELECT V.OSV_ID, V.ID AS INT_ID, V.MODI_DATE, V.PUBL_DATE, V.SUMMARY, CASE WHEN V.WITHDRAWN IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS WITHDRAWN_YN, P.PACKAGE_NAME, P.ECOSYSTEM, CASE WHEN IFNULL(P.ECOSYSTEM, '') <> '' AND IFNULL(P.PACKAGE_NAME, '') <> '' THEN CONCAT(P.ECOSYSTEM, ':', P.PACKAGE_NAME) WHEN IFNULL(P.PURL, '') <> '' THEN P.PURL WHEN IFNULL(G.REPO, '') <> '' THEN G.REPO ELSE '' END AS COMPONENT, CASE WHEN G_TYPE.RANGE_TYPE = 'GIT' THEN V_TXT.VERSION_TEXT ELSE IFNULL(R_TXT.RANGE_VERSION_TEXT, V_TXT.VERSION_TEXT) END AS AFFECTED_VERSION, CASE WHEN G_TYPE.RANGE_TYPE = 'GIT' THEN V_TXT.SORT_VERSION ELSE IFNULL(R_TXT.SORT_VERSION, V_TXT.SORT_VERSION) END AS SORT_VERSION, CASE WHEN IFNULL(P.PURL, '') LIKE 'pkg:github/%' THEN CONCAT( SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(P.PURL, 'pkg:github/', -1), '@', 1), '/', 1), '-', SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(P.PURL, 'pkg:github/', -1), '@', 1), '?', 1), '/', -1) ) WHEN (P.PURL IS NULL OR P.PURL = '') AND IFNULL(G.REPO, '') LIKE '%github.com/%' THEN CONCAT( SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(G.REPO, 'github.com/', -1), '/', 1), '-', SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(G.REPO, 'github.com/', -1), '.git', 1), '/', -1) ) ELSE NULL END AS SEARCH_NAME_P1, P.PURL AS SEARCH_NAME_P2, P.PACKAGE_NAME AS SEARCH_NAME_P3, IFNULL(V_TXT.HAS_VERSIONS_LIST, 'N') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P1_YN, V_TXT.VERSION_TEXT AS SEARCH_VERSION_P1, IFNULL(R_TXT.IS_SEMVER_TYPE, 'N') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P2_YN, R_TXT.SEMVER_RANGE_RAW AS SEARCH_VERSION_P2 FROM OSV_VULNERABILITIES V LEFT JOIN OSV_AFFECTED_PACKAGES P ON V.ID = P.ID LEFT JOIN OSV_VERSION_TEMP V_TXT ON P.ID = V_TXT.INT_ID AND P.PACKAGE_IDX = V_TXT.PACKAGE_IDX LEFT JOIN OSV_RANGE_TEMP R_TXT ON P.ID = R_TXT.INT_ID AND P.PACKAGE_IDX = R_TXT.PACKAGE_IDX LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ID, PACKAGE_IDX, MAX(RANGE_TYPE) AS RANGE_TYPE FROM OSV_AFFECTED_PACKAGE_RANGES GROUP BY ID, PACKAGE_IDX ) G_TYPE ON P.ID = G_TYPE.ID AND P.PACKAGE_IDX = G_TYPE.PACKAGE_IDX LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ID, PACKAGE_IDX, MAX(REPO) AS REPO FROM OSV_AFFECTED_PACKAGE_RANGES WHERE RANGE_TYPE = 'GIT' GROUP BY ID, PACKAGE_IDX ) G ON P.ID = G.ID AND P.PACKAGE_IDX = G.PACKAGE_IDX

CREATE TABLE OSV_SEARCH_MASTER_TEMP ( ID VARCHAR(50), SOURCE VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'OSV', COMPONENT TEXT, AFFECTED_VERSION LONGTEXT, SEVERITY VARCHAR(100) COMMENT 'Calculated numeric score string or raw text rating (Score Only)', SEVERITY_TYPE VARCHAR(30) COMMENT 'Metrics system type (e.g., CVSS_V3, CVSS_V4, Ubuntu)', MODI_DATE DATETIME COMMENT 'Vulnerability last modification date', PUBL_DATE DATETIME COMMENT 'Vulnerability publication date', SUMMARY TEXT COMMENT 'Vulnerability summary description',
WITHDRAWN_YN CHAR(1) DEFAULT 'N' COMMENT 'Withdrawal status (Y: Withdrawn, N: Active)',
SEARCH_NAME_P1 VARCHAR(255) COMMENT 'Priority 1: Unique nickname derived from PURL or Git repo', SEARCH_NAME_P2 VARCHAR(255) COMMENT 'Priority 2: Original PURL string from affected package', SEARCH_NAME_P3 VARCHAR(255) COMMENT 'Priority 3: Original package name string',
SEARCH_VERSION_P1_YN CHAR(1) DEFAULT 'N' COMMENT 'Target Priority 1 flag: Indicates whether exact versions list exists', SEARCH_VERSION_P1 LONGTEXT COMMENT 'Priority 1 matching data: Comma-separated exact version list', SEARCH_VERSION_P2_YN CHAR(1) DEFAULT 'N' COMMENT 'Target Priority 2 flag: Indicates whether SemVer range exists', SEARCH_VERSION_P2 LONGTEXT COMMENT 'Priority 2 matching data: Pipe-separated raw SemVer range criteria', SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN CHAR(1) DEFAULT 'N' COMMENT 'Target Priority 3 flag: Indicates N/A version matching (Name-only matching)' )

INSERT INTO OSV_SEARCH_MASTER_TEMP ( ID, SOURCE, COMPONENT, AFFECTED_VERSION, SEVERITY, SEVERITY_TYPE, MODI_DATE, PUBL_DATE, SUMMARY, WITHDRAWN_YN, SEARCH_NAME_P1, SEARCH_NAME_P2, SEARCH_NAME_P3, SEARCH_VERSION_P1_YN, SEARCH_VERSION_P1, SEARCH_VERSION_P2_YN, SEARCH_VERSION_P2, SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN ) SELECT M.OSV_ID AS ID, 'OSV' AS SOURCE, M.COMPONENT, GROUP_CONCAT(M.AFFECTED_VERSION ORDER BY CASE WHEN M.SORT_VERSION REGEXP '^[0-9]' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, LPAD(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(M.SORT_VERSION, '.', 1), '.', -1), 10, '0') ASC, LPAD(CASE WHEN M.SORT_VERSION LIKE '%.%' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(M.SORT_VERSION, '.', 2), '.', -1) ELSE '0' END, 10, '0') ASC, LPAD(CASE WHEN M.SORT_VERSION LIKE '%.%.%' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(M.SORT_VERSION, '.', 3), '.', -1) ELSE '0' END, 10, '0') ASC, LPAD(CASE WHEN M.SORT_VERSION LIKE '%.%.%.%' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(M.SORT_VERSION, '.', 4), '.', -1) ELSE '0' END, 10, '0') ASC, M.SORT_VERSION ASC SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS AFFECTED_VERSION,
MAX(S.SCORE) AS SEVERITY, MAX(S.TYPE) AS SEVERITY_TYPE, MAX(M.MODI_DATE) AS MODI_DATE, MAX(M.PUBL_DATE) AS PUBL_DATE, MAX(M.SUMMARY) AS SUMMARY, MAX(M.WITHDRAWN_YN) AS WITHDRAWN_YN,
MAX(M.SEARCH_NAME_P1) AS SEARCH_NAME_P1, CAST(MAX(TRIM(M.SEARCH_NAME_P2)) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS SEARCH_NAME_P2, CAST(MAX(TRIM(M.SEARCH_NAME_P3)) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS SEARCH_NAME_P3,
MAX(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1_YN) AS SEARCH_VERSION_P1_YN, GROUP_CONCAT(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 ORDER BY M.SEARCH_VERSION_P1 ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P1, MAX(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2_YN) AS SEARCH_VERSION_P2_YN, GROUP_CONCAT(M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 ORDER BY M.SEARCH_VERSION_P2 ASC SEPARATOR '|') AS SEARCH_VERSION_P2, CASE WHEN (IFNULL(MAX(M.SEARCH_NAME_P1), '') <> '' OR IFNULL(MAX(M.SEARCH_NAME_P2), '') <> '' OR IFNULL(MAX(M.SEARCH_NAME_P3), '') <> '') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SEARCH_VERSION_P3_YN FROM OSV_PRE_MERGE_TEMP M LEFT JOIN OSV_SEVERITY_TEMP S ON M.INT_ID = S.INT_ID GROUP BY M.OSV_ID, M.COMPONENT
UPDATE OSV_SEARCH_MASTER_TEMP SET SEVERITY = '-' WHERE IFNULL(SEVERITY, '') = ''
